# register

Register a new Custom API in Dataverse

## Usage

```
ppds custom-apis register [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unique-name` | yes | Unique message name for the Custom API |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allowed-step-type` |  | `string` |  | Allowed processing step type: None, AsyncOnly, or SyncAndAsync (default: None) |
| `--assembly` |  | `string` |  | Plugin assembly name |
| `--binding-type` |  | `string` |  | Binding type: Global, Entity, or EntityCollection (default: Global) |
| `--bound-entity` |  | `string` |  | Bound entity logical name (required when binding-type is Entity or EntityCollection) |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--description` |  | `string` |  | Optional description |
| `--display-name` |  | `string` |  | Display name for the Custom API (defaults to unique name) |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--execute-privilege` |  | `string` |  | Privilege name required to execute the API |
| `--is-function` |  | `bool` |  | Mark this API as a function (returns a value) |
| `--is-private` |  | `bool` |  | Mark this API as private |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--plugin` |  | `string` |  | Plugin type name (e.g. MyAssembly.MyPlugin) |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
